end.summary:
Practised visualising square and triangular number sequences with dot pictures.
Used rows and columns to show how a sequence grows.
Explained the shared corner when adding a row and column to a square.
Initially gave a mixed-up calculation for a larger square; later represented the new dots as 5 + 5 - 1 = 9.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Ishita practised drawing dot patterns and explaining how square patterns grow from one term to the next. They used the shared corner in a 5-by-5 to 6-by-6 picture and later corrected a larger-square calculation by subtracting the corner counted twice. At home, ask them to draw 3-by-3, 4-by-4, and 5-by-5 squares and mark the new row, new column, and shared corner each time.
